entity.name: ScourgeInfusedSpawner

entity.name: ScourgeBane

entity.name: ScourgeMenacingFlagship
entity.description: 此旗舰是AI为对抗天灾而开发的原型。这是其最强大的形态。

entity.name: ScourgeSeed
entity.description:
This seed will become a 花朵, that finally develops into a 科波麦特 水晶. 花朵 can only grow on on AI planets, as they draw on AI energy sources. The AI will attack them as they grow, so you'll want to neuter some nearby planets.
科波麦特 水晶 can be harvested for 资源.

entity.name: ScourgeFlower
entity.description:
This flower will transform into a 科波麦特 水晶 over time, as they harvest AI energy. If the AI lose control of the planet, the flower will die. The AI will attack them as they grow, so you'll need to defend them.
科波麦特 水晶 can be harvested for 资源.

entity.name: CorbomiteCrystal
entity.description: A reservoir of 科波麦特 has been generated from the AI's energy waves.

entity.name: ScourgeSummoner
entity.description:
发射强力辐射脉冲吸引所有天灾舰船到此建筑。如果它被摧毁，天灾将四散。拥有多个召唤者会混淆你的蜂群，不要这样做。
This structure is quite tanky, and self attritions automatically if you are winning the battle.

entity.name: ScourgeBestiary
entity.description: 此建筑生产强大的天灾怪物来保卫你的领土。

entity.name: VanquisherDefender
entity.description: 征服者是你的天灾附庸用于保卫其领土的极为强大的舰船。
